headline: JP Morgan names ICICI Bank, L&T, and Dixon Technologies as top picks for India's new capex cycle
hook: New growth cycle led by industrial spend
summary: JP Morgan has initiated bullish coverage on India's capital expenditure cycle, identifying specific sector leaders as key beneficiaries. The brokerage has named ICICI Bank, Larsen & Toubro, and Dixon Technologies among its top stock picks to play this economic transition. This highlights institutional confidence in domestic manufacturing, infrastructure expansion, and credit growth. Indian retail investors tracking cyclical and infrastructure themes can use these picks to gauge institutional sentiment.
whats_next: Quarterly earnings delivery from highlighted picks
why_it_matters: Institutional focus shifts toward India's capex and manufacturing leaders
winners_losers: Capex beneficiaries gain / defensive sectors lag

headline: Dixon Technologies arm partners with Aviat Networks for microwave radios
hook: New manufacturing tech licensed for Dixon
summary: Dixon Electro Appliances, a subsidiary and joint venture of Dixon Technologies, has signed an intellectual property licence agreement with Aviat Networks. The partnership enables Dixon to manufacture microwave radios locally. This expansion broadens the company's manufacturing portfolio in the telecom hardware sector. Indian retail investors tracking contract manufacturers can note this addition to Dixon's production capabilities.
why_it_matters: Expands Dixon's electronics manufacturing portfolio into telecom hardware

headline: Dixon Technologies arm signs IP licence agreement with Aviat Networks
hook: New manufacturing tech licensed for microwave radios
summary: Dixon Electroics Appliances Private Limited, a subsidiary of Dixon Technologies, has entered into an intellectual property licence agreement with Aviat Networks. Under the deal, Aviat has granted DEAPL a limited licence to use specified technical know-how for manufacturing microwave radios. This partnership expands the subsidiary's operational capabilities in telecom hardware production. Indian retail investors tracking Dixon Technologies should watch how this manufacturing tie-up impacts its electronics production revenue.
whats_next: Commercial production updates from the Dixon subsidiary
why_it_matters: Expands Dixon's manufacturing portfolio into specialized microwave radio equipment.
